scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
Ah, have you come to
retrieve the memories
lost to you? Yes, you
must be here for the
secrets of life that
were once yours...
scripts.translation:
[生物化学家]
啊，你是来找回
遗失的记忆的吗？
没错，你一定是为了
曾经属于你的
生命奥秘而来的...

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
Close your eyes and
put your mind at rest.
We will return to your
past to recollect the
fragments of your lost
memories.
scripts.translation:
[生物化学家]
闭上双眼，
让心灵平静下来。
我们将回到过去，
重新拾起
你遗失的记忆碎片。

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
When you open your eyes,
you will clearly remember
the secret of life. You will
also remember the weight of
responsibility in using these
secrets for the right ends...
scripts.translation:
[生物化学家]
当你睁开双眼时，
你将清晰地记起
生命的奥秘。
你也会记起
将这些奥秘用于正途
所肩负的责任...

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
Open your eyes...
Now that you have
remembered how to
create artificial life, I only
ask that you treat all of your
creations with respect.
scripts.translation:
[生物化学家]
睁开双眼吧...
既然你已经记起了
如何创造人工生命，
我只希望你能
尊重你创造的一切。

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
If you wish to
retrieve your lost
memories, please
come back to me.
The secret to creating
life is no trifling thing...
scripts.translation:
[生物化学家]
如果你希望
找回遗失的记忆，
请随时回来找我。
创造生命的奥秘
绝非儿戏...

[生物化学家]
恭喜。
向勇士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
It's strange that
someone like me is here.
But even someone skilled
in the ways of science
can manage to be a hero.
scripts.translation:
[生物化学家]
像我这样的人
出现在这里，
真是有些奇怪。
但即使是精通
科学之道的人，
也能成为英雄。

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
In this instance,
it's not necessarily
the means I've used, but
the ends for which I've
fought that earned me
a place in Valhalla...
scripts.translation:
[生物化学家]
就这次而言，
让我登上英灵殿的，
未必是我使用的手段，
而是我战斗的目的...

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
Yes...
It's about time.
We need more geniuses
like you on Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[生物化学家]
是的...
时候到了。
米德加尔特需要
更多像你这样的天才。

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
Would you like to
become a Biochemist?
scripts.translation:
[生物化学家]
你想成为
生物化学家吗？

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
When you're ready,
feel free to come back.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[生物化学家]
当你准备好了，
请随时回来。
向勇士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
It is still possible for you to learn more skills. Please use
all of your remaining Skill Points before returning to me.
scripts.translation:
[生物化学家]
你仍然可以学习更多技能。请在回来找我之前，
用完你剩余的所有技能点。

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
Congratulations!
As a Biochemist,
I hope you use your
vast knowledge for the
right purposes.
scripts.translation:
[生物化学家]
恭喜！
作为一名生物化学家，
我希望你能将
渊博的知识
用于正确的目的。

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[生物化学家]
欢迎来到
英灵殿，
荣耀的大厅。

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[生物化学家]
请在这里
安心休息。
向勇士们致敬！
